body: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase.
Monthly plans are not refundable after the billing date.
Refund requests are processed within 5 business days.
Orders to the EU ship within 3 business days.
Express shipping is available in 12 countries.
Customs fees are paid by the recipient.
All data is encrypted at rest with AES-256.
SSO is available on the Enterprise plan.
Security incidents are disclosed within 72 hours.
Invoices are issued on the first day of each month.
VAT is charged according to the customer's country.
Payment methods include card and bank transfer.
